results.overview: Credit Suisse no longer exists despite being “too big to fail” and despite a reputation built up over a century. How did this happen?

results.title: Get Lost
results.overview: After her younger sister Bea tries to commit suicide, Sofia steals her away from college to camp in the Grand Canyon in an attempt to inspire healing and to mend their relationship.

results.title: Aleshenka
results.overview: A series of unexpected events lead the alien Alyoshenka to Earth. His appearance on the planet spurs supernatural forces into action. And still the cold space and his lost native planet call to him.

results.title: Masaka Kids, A Rhythm Within
results.overview: The story behind the Uganda-based YouTube dance sensations who have endured devastating personal loss from famine and war, and use the power of dance and song to overcome hardship.

results.title: MAYO
results.overview: Brin had a past with the Bones Mafia in the 80s. Decades later, his nephew discovers an artifact while cleaning out his attic, a mysterious jar of mayonnaise. The Bones Mafia is after this item and returns into Brin’s life.

results.title: Bound By a Promise
results.overview: Retired soldier Chen Shisan accepts a high-risk mission to escort the captured thief Su Huan to Baimagu Pass. As vengeful foes and bounty hunters launch relentless attacks, his nine-man team suffers heavy losses. Forced to rely on his veteran instincts, Chen Shisan must battle through deadly ambushes and keep his promise to see the mission through.

results.title: GILDA
results.overview: An evening unfolds in real time as Gilda, a struggling performer, is setting up a kid’s club, finding herself terrorised by an occult presence.

results.title: Family Recipe
results.overview: An intimate look at a Mexican-Lebanese couple’s life through archival footage spanning 48 years. Told from the perspective of their youngest daughter, the film explores their relationship, gender roles, and the influence of cultural traditions on identity.

results.title: ADN
results.overview: Separated as children, twin sisters Hana and Dana grow up in opposite worlds, one in peace and the other in crime. When their paths cross inside a criminal empire, the truth about their past threatens to destroy them both.

results.title: Mitski: The Land
results.overview: Indie singer-songwriter Mitski takes the stage at Atlanta’s Fox Theater with a seven-piece band. Over the course of three nights in September 2024, they perform music from Mitski’s acclaimed seventh album, The Land Is Inhospitable and So Are We, alongside reimaginings of her earlier work.

results.title: Ardisson, l'Homme en Noir : l'hommage
results.overview: This tribute program takes you back into the world of Thierry Ardisson, a particularly creative, provocative, and erudite host and producer. From "Tout le monde en parle" to "Salut les Terriens !", via "Lunettes noires pour nuits blanches", the program retraces his more than 40-year career and his extraordinary journey, featuring cult interviews, testimonials, and archive footage. Numerous guests will pay tribute to him and share their memories and anecdotes on set. Thierry Ardisson, "the man in black," shook up the French audiovisual landscape and left his mark on his era. The program is broadcast on all TV5 Monde channels and on TV5 Québec/Canada.

results.title: A Christmas Murder Mystery
results.overview: Vera Vexley is the editor of the Metropolitan Ledger’s puzzle section, and a part-time consulting detective for the local sheriff’s office. This year, she has been invited to spend the holidays with family friends, the Sterlings, a wealthy family who appears to be hiding enough secrets to stuff a sleigh. Vera soon finds herself helming a murder investigation when someone is found dead on Christmas morning, putting her at odds with the quick-tempered and distraught family members. Can Vera find the culprit before the holidays turn even more deadly?

results.title: Where Pretty Girls Die
results.overview: A criminology student and true-crime club probe a cold case in rural Georgia, exposing town secrets and a hidden killer. Their investigation puts them in the crosshairs of a predator hunting for new victims.

results.title: Spread: Pigs to Slaughter
results.overview: After being locked down, Rex and Amy invite their friends over to a house in the middle of nowhere. A girl named Florence shows up claiming to have been kidnapped and attacked, but unknown to them a killer is hiding among them.
